why_not_a_bare_repin: Overwriting the four constants would convert a conservation guarantee into a rubber stamp: nothing would then record that the payload changed, or bound HOW it may change. v1 is retained and the permitted transformation is stated, so the checker can assert that the delta is ONLY that transformation.
why_not_reverted: The edits are link-target migrations, not changes to scientific prose or to any number. Reverting them would restore relative paths to documents the prepublication compaction removed from the live tree, i.e. it would damage the surviving discovery routes the freeze exists to preserve.
